integrity_interpretation.meaning: The cryptographic identifier binds the committed bytes. It does not establish that a temporal assertion written inside those bytes was objectively true when authored.

git_layer.observed_commit_id_length_description: user reports a 40-hex Git object ID, consistent with traditional SHA-1 Git object IDs

janus_seed_layer.role: JANUS canonical SHA-256 artifact seed; distinct from Git commit object identity

audit_logic: The original artifact is preserved unchanged.
The declared timestamp remains part of the original committed bytes.
The independent technical observation is recorded separately as an audit witness.
A one-second discrepancy is not rewritten away.
Cryptographic integrity and factual truth are treated as separate predicates.
